title: PRISM Framework — Root Configuration Schema
description: Validates .prism/config.yaml — the configuration file that initializes a PRISM landscape in a repository.

version.description: PRISM framework version this landscape targets (e.g., '1.0').

organization.description: Name of the enterprise or organization this landscape describes.

domain.description: Primary domain of the enterprise. Free text — not constrained to IT.

description.description: One to two sentences describing what this landscape covers and its intended scope.

scope.description: full = all five layers active. partial = selected layers only. scoped = bounded to a department or capability.

active_layers.description: The PRISM layers actively maintained in this landscape. Omit layers not relevant to current scope.

baseline_as_of.description: The date the current baseline artifacts were accurate.

target_date.description: The date by which the target architecture is expected to be achieved.

contacts.description: Primary contacts for this PRISM landscape.

tags.description: Free-text tags for indexing and tooling (e.g., 'cloud-migration', 'regulatory', 'mvp').
